note: Gong et al. 2021 -- trained directly on classification targets (AudioSet supervised).
Kong et al. 2020 (PANNs CNN14) -- trained directly on classification targets (AudioSet supervised, no attention layers).
Radford et al. 2023 -- trained directly on a sequence-to-sequence (ASR transcript) target.
Elizalde et al. 2023 -- aligns audio and text embeddings via a multimodal contrastive loss.

Pellegrini et al. 2023 -- excluded from every adaptation condition (non-differentiable feature extraction as released); participates in the frozen-probe geometry evaluation only, no gain/adaptation data exists for this model.
Chen et al. 2022c (wav2vec 2.0 Conformer) -- Conformer relative-position attention variant of wav2vec2.
Won et al. 2023 (MusicFM, BEST-RQ) -- masked-token-prediction/reconstruction-style objective, grouped here not under joint-embedding/self-distillation.
Tuncay et al. 2024 (Audio-JEPA) -- predicts latent representations without tokenisation or reconstruction (EMA teacher + separate predictor network).
Baevski et al. 2022 (data2vec-audio) -- predicts latent representations without tokenisation or reconstruction.
Li et al. 2022 (music2vec) -- predicts latent representations without tokenisation or reconstruction, data2vec-lineage.
